strengths: Core concept of searching for a tiny detail in a massive crowd translateable to hidden-object style puzzle hooks
Low visual audio dependency makes audio easy to swap for sound effects
concerns: Original format relies heavily on regional language and TV show context that fails globally
Visual execution is cluttered and difficult to parse visually within the first 2 seconds
Bridge to match-3 gameplay is indirect and forced compared to direct puzzle mechanics
rejection_reasons: Requires deep cultural and linguistic context to understand the comedic premise
Visual clutter in initial seconds lacks immediate clear conflict for a broad global mobile audience
adaptation_idea: Show King Robert lost in a massive, chaotic castle crowd, prompting the player to tap or zoom in on the exact spot to rescue him before time runs out.
